Subject: VisionWise onboarding + premium support — scope questions

Hi Ava / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We're excited about Redwood's latency profile and the model routing features — good fit for our CVD triage pilot. A couple of procurement items before we loop legal:

- Can you confirm that the onboarding package includes the custom connector work we discussed (FHIR ingestion + encrypted S3 sync)?
- VisionWise needs premium support for year one included in the subscription; is that something you can bundle at no additional seat cost?
- Finally, we were hoping for a consolidated price that includes 3 integration sprints (estimate ~120 hours) and a first-year discount — would Redwood consider a promo concession to accelerate procurement?

We're on a tight timeline to start the pilot in October. If you can send an updated SOW + draft MSA with those items called out, I'll circulate to Procurement and Legal.

Thanks,

Hi Lena — great to hear this moves fast for you. Recap below and a concrete ask for internal approval.

Summary of proposed bundle (what we'll include in the attached SOW/MSA draft):
- Platform: Hosted Redwood API, enterprise plan (throughput profile B)
- Premium Support: Included for first 12 months (priority routing, 15-minute paging for Sev1s, extended business-hours Slack)
- Onboarding: 30-day onboarding package that includes two integration sprints + one validation sprint (planning assumes ~120 hours total for FHIR connector + S3 encrypted sync)
- Professional Services: Fixed-fee PS line for integration work (line item in pricing-sheet.xlsx)

Concession request to Deal Desk / Execs:
- VisionWise asks for a one-time 20% discount on Professional Services and inclusion of Premium Support at no extra subscription cost for year one.
- They also request a modified SLA: 99.5% uptime and 12-hour response for Sev2 for the pilot; this is outside our standard enterprise SLA.

Attachments I'm sending: MSA-Draft-VisionWise.docx, VisionWise_SOW_v1.pdf, pricing-sheet.xlsx

Action I need from internal team:
- Ben / Marissa / Product: sign off on the PS discount and SLA variance so I can lock pricing with Procurement.
- If approved, I'll push the addendum for Legal and send the DocuSign link to VisionWise.

Lena, feel free to flag anything missing. We can thread Legal once internal approvals are confirmed.

Best,

Ava — looping in a couple of quick points from SE/Finance perspective.

Thanks for the clear summary. A few constraints to call out:
- 20% off PS is high for fixed-fee integration work at this scale; finance is likely to push back. Recommend max 15% or a staged discount (15% now, additional credit applied if they extend to year 2).
- SLA variance to 99.5% / 12-hr Sev2: engineering can commit to the pilot posture, but we should tie it to the pilot's traffic threshold and include a time-boxed operational review at 30 days (we should document this in the SOW).
- For the custom connector, suggest we cap undiscounted PS hours at 140 and convert incremental hours to T&M at the normal hourly rate after written change request. That protects us from scope creep.

If Marissa signs off on a one-time 18% concession and the change-control language, I can live with that. Otherwise, let's reduce to 15% and include a renewal-triggered credit.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

- SLA variance accepted for pilot (99.5% uptime / 12-hour Sev2 response) provided we include a 30-day operational review clause in the SOW and the cap/callout on PS hours (140 hours cap; excess T&M).
